# NEYU Health

> NEYU Health is a cardiology and internal medicine clinic in Calgary, Alberta, Canada, with AI-guided care. It brings heart testing, specialist care, prevention, longevity and a private patient health space together in one place. Neyu is the clinic's AI health companion; it explains health information and never diagnoses.

## Clinics
- North East: 201 – 3151 27 St NE, Calgary, AB T1Y 0B4 · 403-475-4475
- Meadow Miles: 250 – 8500 Blackfoot Trail SE, Calgary, AB T2J 7E1 · 403-879-7911
- Referral-based specialty clinic (Alberta). In an emergency, call 911.

## Diagnostics
- [Diagnostics overview](https://neyuhealth.com/diagnostics): cardiac imaging (echocardiography), exercise stress testing incl. stress echo, heart rhythm monitoring (Holter), pulmonary function, vascular studies
- Test pages (what each test is, how long it takes, how to prepare): [Cardiac imaging](https://neyuhealth.com/diagnostics/cardiac-imaging) · [Stress testing](https://neyuhealth.com/diagnostics/stress-testing) · [Monitoring](https://neyuhealth.com/diagnostics/monitoring) · [Vascular](https://neyuhealth.com/diagnostics/vascular) · [Pulmonary function](https://neyuhealth.com/diagnostics/pulmonary) · [Clinic services](https://neyuhealth.com/services)

## My Health Space
- [My Health Space](https://neyuhealth.com/my-health/sign-up): a private, provider-neutral personal health record. Patients add reports from any doctor, lab or hospital (upload, scan or photo), connect Apple Health, Oura, WHOOP and Withings, log food, get an AI health plan and create a Doctor Assessment PDF to bring to any doctor. AI content is always labelled; original reports are kept unchanged.

## Free AI tools (Neyu)
- [Meet Neyu](https://neyuhealth.com/neyu) · [Lab Result Explainer](https://neyuhealth.com/lab-results) · [Explain My Diagnosis](https://neyuhealth.com/explain-diagnosis). Neyu explains; it never diagnoses.
